title: Part 1 : 2019: Ceramic Tiles — Methods of Test, Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 1 Determination of Dimensions and Surface Quality ( Second Revision )
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard (Part 1) covers methods for determining the dimensional characteristics (length, width, thickness, straightness of sides, rectangularity, surface flatness) and the surface quality of all ceramic tiles. 1.2 Tiles with area less than 400 mm? are excluded from measurements of length, width, thickness, straightness of sides, rectangularity, and surface flatness. 1.3 Spacer lugs, glaze bobs and other irregularities of the sides shall be ignored when measuring length, width, and straightness of sides, rectangularity if these are subsequently hidden in the joints after fixing.
clause_3_terminology: Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 1 Determination of Dimensions and Surface Quality

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
